# KPI Catalog - Innovation & People

---

Schema: see `/_includes/kpi_catalog/SCHEMA.md`

## KPIs - Strategic
```yaml
- kpi_id: "people.new_product_share"
  kpi_key: "New Product Share %"
  kpi_type: "strategic"
  domain_tag: ["Customer & Market"]
  calc_type: "rate"
  business:
    purpose:
      "Show how much of revenue is generated by recently launched products."
    definition:
      "Revenue from products launched in the last X months / Total revenue."
    grain_scope:
      "Product/category/region; aggregated monthly or quarterly."
    unit_format:
      "% (1 decimal)"
  technical:
    dax_name:
      "New Product Share %"
    formatString:
      "0.0 %"
    description:
      "Sales of products <12 months / Total Sales"
  governance:
    business_owner:
      "Head of Category Management / Product Strategy"
    data_owner:
      "Commercial BI"
    steward:
      "Category Analyst"
    review_cycle:
      "quarterly"
    validation_process:
      "manual review"
    qa_rules:
      "Launch dates maintained for all new products; share bounded between 0 % and 100 %."
    version:
      "v1.0"
    last_review:
      "2025-11-04"

- kpi_id: "people.innovation_rate.pct"
  kpi_key: "Innovation Rate %"
  kpi_type: "strategic"
  strategic_ref: "Innovation Rate %"
  impact_dimension: "Innovation & People"
  domain_tag: ["Corporate & Strategy"]
  use_case_ref: "INN-001"
  depends_on:
    - "Revenue from New Products"
    - "Total Revenue"
  depends_on_ids: "people.total_revenue.amount"
  calc_type: "ratio"
  refresh: "quarterly"
  status: "Active"
  business:
    purpose:
      "Share of revenue generated by products launched within the last 3 years."
    definition:
      "Revenue from New Products / Total Revenue"
    grain_scope:
      "Company level, aggregated quarterly."
    unit_format:
      "% (1 decimal)"
    interpretation:
      "Indicates innovation effectiveness and portfolio freshness."
  technical:
    dax_name:
      "Innovation Rate %"
    dax_expression:
      "DIVIDE([Revenue from New Products],[Total Revenue])"
    formatString:
      "0.0 %"
    description:
      "Percentage of revenue generated by products launched within the last 3 years."
    lineage:
      - "fact_sales.NewProductRevenue"
      - "fact_sales.TotalRevenue"
    source_grain:
      "product"
    source_column_ref:
      "fact_sales.new_product_revenue"
    source_system:
      "ERP"
    verified:
      "true"
  governance:
    business_owner:
      "Head of Strategy & Innovation"
    data_owner:
      "Corporate BI"
    steward:
      "Innovation Analyst"
    review_cycle:
      "quarterly"
    validation_process:
      "manual review"
    qa_rules:
      "New Product flag validated by Product Master"
    version:
      "v2.0"
    last_review:
      "12.10.2025"
  metadata_quality:
    completeness_score:
      "0.96"
    lineage_verified:
      "true"
    copilot_ready:
      "true"

- kpi_id: "people.employee_engagement.pct"
  kpi_key: "Employee Engagement %"
  kpi_type: "strategic"
  strategic_ref: "Employee Engagement %"
  impact_dimension: "Innovation & People"
  domain_tag: ["Human Resources"]
  use_case_ref: "HR-001"
  depends_on:
    - "Engaged Employees"
    - "Survey Respondents"
  depends_on_ids:
    - "people.engaged_employees.count"
    - "people.survey_respondents.count"
  calc_type: "ratio"
  refresh: "annual"
  status: "Active"
  business:
    purpose:
      "Measures emotional commitment of employees towards the company."
    definition:
      "Engaged Employees / Survey Respondents"
    grain_scope:
      "HR survey level."
    unit_format:
      "% (1 decimal)"
    interpretation:
      "High engagement supports productivity and retention."
  technical:
    dax_name:
      "Employee Engagement %"
    dax_expression:
      "DIVIDE([Engaged Employees],[Survey Respondents])"
    formatString:
      "0.0 %"
    description:
      "Share of engaged employees among survey respondents."
    lineage:
      - "fact_hrsurvey.EngagedEmployees"
      - "fact_hrsurvey.TotalRespondents"
    source_grain:
      "employee"
    source_column_ref:
      "fact_hrsurvey.engaged_flag"
    source_system:
      "HR Survey Platform"
    verified:
      "true"
  governance:
    business_owner:
      "Head of HR"
    data_owner:
      "HR Analytics"
    steward:
      "People Analyst"
    review_cycle:
      "annual"
    validation_process:
      "manual review"
    qa_rules:
      "Survey participation ≥ 70 %"
    version:
      "v2.0"
    last_review:
      "12.10.2025"
  metadata_quality:
    completeness_score:
      "0.95"
    lineage_verified:
      "true"
    copilot_ready:
      "true"
```


## KPIs - Supporting / Diagnostic
```yaml
- kpi_id: "people.product_contribution_margin"
  kpi_key: "Product Contribution Margin %"
  kpi_type: "diagnostic"
  domain_tag: ["Customer & Market"]
  calc_type: "rate"
  business:
    purpose:
      "Assess profitability of individual products after direct variable and promotional costs."
    definition:
      "(Net Sales - COGS - Promo Cost) / Net Sales."
    grain_scope:
      "Product/category/region; aggregated monthly."
    unit_format:
      "% (1 decimal)"
  technical:
    dax_name:
      "Contribution Margin %"
    formatString:
      "0.0 %"
    description:
      "(NS - COGS - Promo Cost) / NS"
  governance:
    business_owner:
      "Head of Category Management"
    data_owner:
      "Commercial BI"
    steward:
      "Category Analyst"
    review_cycle:
      "quarterly"
    validation_process:
      "manual review"
    qa_rules:
      "Contribution margin reconciles to gross margin reporting within +/- 0.5 pp; bounded between -100 % and +100 %."
    version:
      "v1.0"
    last_review:
      "2025-11-04"

    grain_scope:
      "Product; evaluated at reporting date."
    unit_format:
      "months (0 decimals)"
  technical:
    dax_name:
      "Lifecycle Age (months)"
    formatString:
      "0"
    description:
      "Months since first sale"
  governance:
    business_owner:
      "Head of Category Management"
    data_owner:

    steward:
      "Product Master Data Steward"
    review_cycle:
      "quarterly"
    validation_process:

    last_review:

- kpi_id: "people.product_roi"
  kpi_key: "Product ROI %"
  kpi_type: "diagnostic"
  domain_tag: ["Customer & Market"]
  calc_type: "rate"
  business:
    purpose:
      "Evaluate whether individual products generate sufficient return relative to their development and marketing investments."
    definition:
      "(GM - DevCost - MktCost) / (DevCost + MktCost)."
    grain_scope:
      "Product; cumulative over the chosen evaluation horizon."
    unit_format:
      "% (1 decimal)"
  technical:
    dax_name:
      "Product ROI %"
    formatString:
      "0.0 %"
    description:
      "(GM - DevCost - MktCost) / (DevCost + MktCost)"
  governance:
    business_owner:
      "Head of Category Management"
    data_owner:
      "Commercial BI"
    steward:
      "Category Analyst"
    review_cycle:
      "quarterly"
    validation_process:
      "manual review"
    qa_rules:
      "ROI bounded between -100 % and +500 % for plausibility checks; zero or missing investments flagged as non-evaluable."
    version:
      "v1.0"
    last_review:
      "2025-11-04"

- kpi_id: "hr.revenue_per_fte.amount"
  kpi_key: "Revenue per FTE"
  kpi_type: "strategic"
  strategic_ref: "Revenue per FTE"
  impact_dimension: "efficiency"
  domain_tag: ["Corporate & Strategy"]
  use_case_ref: ["COR-002"]
  calc_type: "ratio"
  refresh: "monthly"
  status: "Active"
  business:
    purpose: "Measure how much revenue is generated per full-time equivalent to assess workforce productivity."
    definition: "Total Revenue Amount / Average FTE over the period."
    grain_scope: "Org / department; monthly or quarterly closing."
    unit_format: "EUR per FTE (0 decimals)"
    interpretation: "Higher values indicate more productive use of workforce; compare across time and peer units with similar business models."
  technical:
    dax_name: "Revenue per FTE"
    dax_expression: "DIVIDE([Revenue Amount],[Average FTE])"
    displayFolder: "COR Workforce"
    formatString: "#,0"
    description: "Revenue divided by average FTE for the selected period and org."
    lineage: ["fact_financials.RevenueAmount","fact_hr_headcount.FTEFactor"]
    source_grain: "org_month"
    source_column_ref: ["fact_financials.RevenueAmount","fact_hr_headcount.FTEFactor"]
    source_system: "ERP_HR"
    verified: false
  governance:
    business_owner: "Head of HR Controlling"
    data_owner: "People Analytics"
    steward: "HR Analyst"
    review_cycle: "quarterly"
    validation_process: "reconciled against Finance revenue and HR headcount totals"
    qa_rules:
      - "Check reconciliation to Finance revenue within +/- 0.5 %"
      - "Average FTE > 0 for any reported slice"
    version: "v1.0"
    last_review: "04.11.2025"

- kpi_id: "hr.gm_per_fte.amount"
  kpi_key: "Gross Margin per FTE"
  kpi_type: "diagnostic"
  strategic_ref: "Revenue per FTE"
  impact_dimension: "efficiency"
  domain_tag: ["Corporate & Strategy"]
  use_case_ref: ["COR-002"]
  calc_type: "ratio"
  refresh: "monthly"
  status: "Active"
  business:
    purpose: "Show how much gross margin is generated per full-time equivalent, factoring both productivity and margin quality."
    definition: "Gross Margin Amount / Average FTE over the period."
    grain_scope: "Org / department; monthly or quarterly closing."
    unit_format: "EUR per FTE (0 decimals)"
    interpretation: "Higher values indicate more profitable utilization of workforce; track trends and compare similar units."
  technical:
    dax_name: "Gross Margin per FTE"
    dax_expression: "DIVIDE([Gross Margin Amount],[Average FTE])"
    displayFolder: "COR Workforce"
    formatString: "#,0"
    description: "Gross margin divided by average FTE for the selected period and org."
    lineage: ["fact_financials.GrossMarginAmount","fact_hr_headcount.FTEFactor"]
    source_grain: "org_month"
    source_column_ref: ["fact_financials.GrossMarginAmount","fact_hr_headcount.FTEFactor"]
    source_system: "ERP_HR"
    verified: false
  governance:
    business_owner: "Head of HR Controlling"
    data_owner: "People Analytics"
    steward: "HR Analyst"
    review_cycle: "quarterly"
    validation_process: "cross-checked with margin and FTE reconciliations"
    qa_rules:
      - "Gross Margin Amount reconciles to Finance within +/- 0.5 %"
      - "Average FTE > 0 for any reported slice"
    version: "v1.0"
    last_review: "04.11.2025"

- kpi_id: "prod.lifecycle.new_share.pct"
  kpi_key: "New Product Share %"
  kpi_type: "strategic"
  strategic_ref: "Innovation Revenue %"
  impact_dimension: "growth"
  domain_tag: ["Customer & Market"]
  use_case_ref: ["CST-002"]
  calc_type: "rate"
  refresh: "monthly"
  status: "Active"
  business:
    purpose: "Measure how much of total revenue is generated by recently launched products."
    definition: "Revenue from products launched in the last X months / Total revenue."
    grain_scope: "Product / category / org; monthly or quarterly."
    unit_format: "% (1 decimal)"
    interpretation: "Higher share indicates a fresher portfolio and stronger innovation contribution to growth."
  technical:
    dax_name: "New Product Share %"
    dax_expression: "DIVIDE([Revenue New Products],[Revenue Amount])"
    displayFolder: "CST Product Lifecycle"
    formatString: "0.0 %"
    description: "Revenue from new products divided by total revenue."
    lineage: ["fact_sales.Net Sales Amount","dim_product.LaunchDate"]
    source_grain: "invoice_line"
    source_column_ref: ["fact_sales.Net Sales Amount","dim_product.LaunchDate"]
    source_system: "ERP"
    verified: false
  governance:
    business_owner: "Head of Category Management"
    data_owner: "Commercial BI"
    steward: "Category Analyst"
    review_cycle: "quarterly"
    validation_process: "cross-checked with product master and innovation tracking"
    qa_rules:
      - "LaunchDate populated for all SKUs considered 'new'"
      - "Share bounded between 0 % and 100 %"
    version: "v1.0"
    last_review: "04.11.2025"

- kpi_id: "prod.contribution_margin.pct"
  kpi_key: "Product Contribution Margin %"
  kpi_type: "diagnostic"
  strategic_ref: "Gross Margin %"
  impact_dimension: "profitability"
  domain_tag: ["Customer & Market"]
  use_case_ref: ["CST-002"]
  calc_type: "rate"
  refresh: "monthly"
  status: "Active"
  business:
    purpose: "Assess profitability of individual products after direct variable costs and promotional spend."
    definition: "(Net Sales - COGS - Promo Cost - Marketing Cost) / Net Sales."
    grain_scope: "Product / category / org; monthly."
    unit_format: "% (1 decimal)"
    interpretation: "Higher values indicate more profitable products; negative margins highlight candidates for price, cost, or portfolio action."
  technical:
    dax_name: "Product Contribution Margin %"
    dax_expression: "VAR _ns = [Net Sales Amount] RETURN IF(_ns=0, BLANK(), DIVIDE([Net Sales Amount]-[COGS Amount]-[Promo Cost Amount]-[Marketing Cost Amount], _ns))"
    displayFolder: "CST Product Lifecycle"
    formatString: "0.0 %"
    description: "Product-level contribution margin rate after direct variable and promotional costs."
    lineage: ["fact_sales.Net Sales Amount","fact_sales.COGS Amount","fact_sales.Promo Cost Amount","fact_marketing.Marketing Cost Amount"]
    source_grain: "invoice_line"
    source_column_ref: ["fact_sales.Net Sales Amount","fact_sales.COGS Amount","fact_sales.Promo Cost Amount"]
    source_system: "ERP"
    verified: false
  governance:
    business_owner: "Head of Category Management"
    data_owner: "Commercial BI"
    steward: "Category Analyst"
    review_cycle: "quarterly"
    validation_process: "reconciled with margin reporting and campaign accounting"
    qa_rules:
      - "Contribution margin reconciles to GM within +/- 0.5 pp when aggregated"
      - "Bounded between -100 % and 100 %"
    version: "v1.0"
    last_review: "04.11.2025"

- kpi_id: "prod.lifecycle.age.months"
  kpi_key: "Lifecycle Age (months)"
  kpi_type: "diagnostic"
  impact_dimension: "customer"
  domain_tag: ["Customer & Market"]
  use_case_ref: ["CST-002"]
  calc_type: "amount"
  refresh: "monthly"
  status: "Active"
  business:
    purpose: "Track how long a product has been in the market to support lifecycle phase classification."
    definition: "Months between Launch Date and current reporting date."
    grain_scope: "Product; evaluated at reporting date."
    unit_format: "months (0 decimals)"
    interpretation: "Used as an input to assign lifecycle phase and interpret performance by maturity stage."
  technical:
    dax_name: "Lifecycle Age (months)"
    dax_expression: "DATEDIFF([Launch Date],[Today Date],MONTH)"
    displayFolder: "CST Product Lifecycle"
    formatString: "0"
    description: "Number of months since product launch."
    lineage: ["dim_product.LaunchDate","dim_date.Date"]
    source_grain: "product"
    source_column_ref: ["dim_product.LaunchDate"]
    source_system: "PIM"
    verified: false
  governance:
    business_owner: "Head of Category Management"
    data_owner: "Master Data Management"
    steward: "Product Master Data Steward"
    review_cycle: "annual"
    validation_process: "launch dates cross-checked with product master and project documentation"
    qa_rules:
      - "Launch Date not in the future"
      - "Age >= 0 months"
    version: "v1.0"
    last_review: "04.11.2025"

- kpi_id: "prod.lifecycle.phase_distribution.pct"
  kpi_key: "Lifecycle Phase Distribution %"
  kpi_type: "diagnostic"
  strategic_ref: "Innovation Revenue %"
  impact_dimension: "growth"
  domain_tag: ["Customer & Market"]
  use_case_ref: ["CST-002"]
  calc_type: "rate"
  refresh: "monthly"
  status: "Active"
  business:
    purpose: "Show revenue mix across lifecycle phases (Launch, Growth, Maturity, Decline, Phase-Out)."
    definition: "Revenue in phase / Total revenue for the selected slice."
    grain_scope: "Lifecycle phase / category / org; monthly."
    unit_format: "% (stacked)"
    interpretation: "Helps assess portfolio health; balanced mix with sufficient Launch/Growth share and managed tail in Decline/Phase-Out."
  technical:
    dax_name: "Lifecycle Phase Distribution %"
    dax_expression: "DIVIDE([Revenue Amount],[Revenue Total All Phases])"
    displayFolder: "CST Product Lifecycle"
    formatString: "0.0 %"
    description: "Share of revenue per lifecycle phase."
    lineage: ["fact_sales.Net Sales Amount","fact_product_investment.LifecycleStage"]
    source_grain: "invoice_line"
    source_column_ref: ["fact_sales.Net Sales Amount","fact_product_investment.LifecycleStage"]
    source_system: "ERP_PIM"
    verified: false
  governance:
    business_owner: "Head of Category Management"
    data_owner: "Commercial BI"
    steward: "Category Analyst"
    review_cycle: "quarterly"
    validation_process: "phase assignments validated in lifecycle classification job"
    qa_rules:
      - "Phase shares per slice sum to approx. 100 %"
      - "LifecycleStage maintained for all active SKUs"
    version: "v1.0"
    last_review: "04.11.2025"

- kpi_id: "prod.roi.pct"
  kpi_key: "Product ROI %"
  kpi_type: "diagnostic"
  strategic_ref: "Product Contribution Margin %"
  impact_dimension: "profitability"
  domain_tag: ["Customer & Market"]
  use_case_ref: ["CST-002"]
  calc_type: "rate"
  refresh: "quarterly"
  status: "Active"
  business:
    purpose: "Evaluate whether individual products generate sufficient return relative to their development and marketing investments."
    definition: "(Cumulative Gross Margin - Development Cost - Marketing Cost) / (Development Cost + Marketing Cost)."
    grain_scope: "Product; cumulative over the chosen evaluation horizon."
    unit_format: "% (1 decimal)"
    interpretation: "ROI above 0 % indicates that investments have been recovered and value created; negative ROI highlights candidates for corrective action."
  technical:
    dax_name: "Product ROI %"
    dax_expression: "VAR _den = [Development Cost Amount] + [Marketing Cost Amount] RETURN IF(_den=0, BLANK(), DIVIDE([Gross Margin Amount]-_den,_den))"
    displayFolder: "CST Product Lifecycle"
    formatString: "0.0 %"
    description: "Return on investment for a product vs its development and marketing spend."
    lineage: ["margin.gm.amount","fact_product_investment.DevelopmentCost","fact_product_investment.MarketingCost"]
    source_grain: "product"
    source_column_ref: ["fact_product_investment.DevelopmentCost","fact_product_investment.MarketingCost"]
    source_system: "ERP_PIM"
    verified: false
  governance:
    business_owner: "Head of Category Management"
    data_owner: "Commercial BI"
    steward: "Category Analyst"
    review_cycle: "annual"
    validation_process: "investment and GM reconciled with project accounting"
    qa_rules:
      - "ROI bounded between -100 % and +500 % for plausibility checks"
      - "Zero or missing investments flagged as non-evaluable"
    version: "v1.0"
    last_review: "04.11.2025"

- kpi_id: "people.digital_adoption.pct"
  kpi_key: "Digital Adoption Rate %"
  kpi_type: "strategic"
  strategic_ref: "Digital Adoption Rate %"
  impact_dimension: "Innovation & People"
  domain_tag: ["Corporate & Strategy"]
  use_case_ref: "INN-002"
  depends_on:
    - "Digital Transactions Count"
    - "Total Transactions Count"
  calc_type: "ratio"
  refresh: "quarterly"
  status: "Active"
  business:
    purpose:
      "Measure how much of all eligible process transactions are executed via digital tools instead of manual channels."
    definition:
      "Digital Transactions Count / Total Transactions Count for eligible processes."
    grain_scope:
      "Process area / org; aggregated monthly or quarterly."
    unit_format:
      "% (1 decimal)"
    interpretation:
      "Higher values indicate greater adoption of digital processes; low values show manual work and automation potential."
  technical:
    dax_name:
      "Digital Adoption Rate %"
    dax_expression:
      "DIVIDE([Digital Transactions Count],[Total Transactions Count])"
    displayFolder:
      "INN Digital"
    formatString:
      "0.0 %"
    description:
      "Share of digital transactions in total process transactions for eligible processes."
    lineage:
      - "fact_digital_usage.TransactionsCount"
    source_grain:
      "process_user_day"
    source_column_ref:
      "fact_digital_usage.TransactionsCount"
    source_system:
      "Digital usage tracking / telemetry"
    verified:
      "false"
  governance:
    business_owner:
      "Head of Digital Transformation"
    data_owner:
      "Corporate BI"
    steward:
      "Digital Adoption Analyst"
    review_cycle:
      "quarterly"
    validation_process:
      "comparison with process mining and application telemetry"
    qa_rules:
      - "Eligible processes flagged correctly; adoption bounded between 0 % and 100 %"
    version:
      "v1.0"
    last_review:
      "2025-11-19"
  metadata_quality:
    completeness_score:
      "0.85"
    lineage_verified:
      "false"
    copilot_ready:
      "true"
```
